statistical_unit: Independent seed; paired two-sided 95% Student-t intervals per endpoint and condition, not simultaneous.
calibration: For each condition and family select the cheapest development configuration whose team, worst-task and worst-event paired loss upper limits are all <=0.01. Full family with no eligible configuration remains unqualified; simple families include the dense endpoint.
cost_scope: Actual payload bit-hop served after warmup, including service for old queued messages, partial transmissions and eventually expired packets. Receiver-context acquisition and topology signaling are not charged.
policy_scope: All methods share sensors, controller, routes, physical multicast, deadlines, balanced opportunity phases and exogenous blackout schedules. Blackout labels are evaluation-only. Simple rules do not use receiver beliefs or control scores. Diagnostic value samples do not feed any policy.
